# fastsql

> fastsql は SQLAlchemy を基盤とする Python ライブラリで、データベースのテーブル操作を Pythonic な API（CRUD・dataclass サポート・マイグレーション）で提供し、SQL の手書きを最小化する。

---

## 2.1.1

### New Features

## 2.1.0

### Breaking Changes

- Align fastsql core with fastlite-style APIs ([#23](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fastsql/pull/23)), thanks to [@ncoop57](https://github.com/ncoop57)

### New Features

- Add fastmigrate system ([#24](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fastsql/pull/24)), thanks to [@ncoop57](https://github.com/ncoop57)
- add markdown to doc output ([#20](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fastsql/issues/20))


## 2.0.3

### New Features

- Use new fastcore `UNSET` as `asdict` ([#18](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fastsql/issues/18))


## 2.0.2

### New Features

- Support dict and kwarg update args ([#14](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fastsql/issues/14))


## 2.0.1

### New Features

### Bugs Squashed

## 2.0.0

## Source Modules

### db_dc

*Source: db_dc.py | URL: https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fastsql/blob/main/db_dc.py*

- `Album`
- `Artist`
- `Customer`
- `Employee`
- `Genre`
- `Invoice`
- `Invoiceline`
- `Mediatype`
- `Playlist`
- `Playlisttrack`
- `Track`

### fastsql.core

*Source: fastsql/core.py | URL: https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fastsql/blob/main/fastsql/core.py*

- `Default`
- `Database`: A connection to a SQLAlchemy database
- `DBTable`: A connection to a SQLAlchemy table, created if needed
- `database`: Create a `Database` from a path or connection string
- `all_dcs`: dataclasses for all objects in `db`
- `create_mod`: Create module for dataclasses for `db`
- `get_typ`: Get the underlying type.
- `NotFoundError`
- `MissingPrimaryKey`
- `Meta`
